answer: Each work slot costs a 40 POA deposit, burned and logged in a sable vault. An agent claims a slot only after filing a work report, while a bought identity pays the same burn. Forging 100 identities burns 4,000 POA against 2,500 POA of pay, net loss 1,500 POA, so the ocean of fakes drowns in cost. An honest agent pays 40 POA once, earns 25 POA per epoch, 20 epochs, and keeps 460 POA profit, undiluted because each fake destroyed its own deposit.
